result.title: Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
result.comment: The Project Page is: https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3. The Paper is published in ACM TOG (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026)
result.summary: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a latent space and only then modeled by the generator. We take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that discards the VAE altogether and operates in the native voxel domain, directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling. To make this direct voxel formulation geometrically reliable, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization over neighboring voxels to suppress non-watertight surfaces, and convert predicted SDF grids into meshes via Marching Cubes so that rendered normal losses can supervise the model directly from its predicted SDF. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape. This latent-free design removes the reconstruction bottleneck, brings training under an objective in the native voxel domain, and yields meshes with substantially richer local detail. The predicted camera and native SDF voxel output further make Direct3D-V3 extensible to generative reconstruction, where diffusion is interleaved with normal-guided refinement to improve alignment with the observed view while the generative prior completes unseen regions. Project page: https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Direct3D-V3，放弃 VAE 与隐空间，直接在原始 SDF 体素域上用扩散 Transformer 建模三维几何，并加入邻域隐式流形正则、Marching Cubes 渲染法向损失与相机参数辅助预测，以避免重建瓶颈。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「取消压缩隐空间、在原生域建模以保留局部细节」的论证，可能与 LVR 中「latent 状态是否保存任务必要的视觉细节、编码压缩是否造成信息坍缩」的问题表述形成类比，可供核查其诊断依据是否可迁移。
